title: HomeModel
description: THE contract of the Escape Plan project (v1.0, finalized in S0.2). One JSON document describes a home: the scan converter produces it, the editor mutates it, the routing engine consumes it, the agent inspects it, the renderer draws it. All linear units are meters; room footprints are 2D polygons in floor-local coordinates (3D is derived by extrusion — meshes are never stored). Structural invariants that JSON Schema cannot express (CCW non-self-intersecting polygons, cross-references, global id uniqueness) are enforced by backend/app/models.py; both validators must pass.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract. Any change to the schema after S0.2 requires bumping this value plus team sign-off.

home_id.description: Stable UUID identifying this home document (generated on creation, never changes; used as the local persistence key).

name.description: User-facing display name of the home, e.g. "Our House".

floors.description: The floors of the home, each with its own rooms and openings. Levels must be unique across floors.

stairs.description: Stair connections between rooms on different floors. In the navigation graph a stair is an edge between its two endpoint rooms with a traversal cost higher than a same-floor edge.

profiles.description: Household member profiles. Tags map deterministically to routing constraints (e.g. mobility_limited → avoid_stairs + avoid_windows) and personalize explanations.

prefixItems.description: x coordinate in meters, floor-local frame.
y coordinate in meters, floor-local frame.

point.description: A 2D point [x, y] in meters, in the floor-local coordinate frame.

polygon.description: A simple closed polygon as an ordered vertex list (the closing edge last→first is implicit; do not repeat the first vertex). Must be counter-clockwise and non-self-intersecting (enforced by pydantic). Edge i runs from vertex i to vertex (i+1) mod n — wall_segment.edge_index uses this convention.

source.description: Provenance of this element: 'scan' = derived from a RoomPlan capture (must carry confidence; low-confidence items are flagged for editor review, never silently dropped); 'manual' = created or confirmed by the user in the editor.

confidence.description: Detection confidence in [0,1]. Required when source is 'scan' (enforced by pydantic); optional for manual elements. The editor highlights low values for review.

id.description: Unique id of the room across the whole home. 'EXTERIOR' is a reserved pseudo-room id and may never be used for a real room.

type.description: Room category. Drives rendering accents and safety logic — rooms typed 'bedroom' require an emergency escape opening (IRC R310.1).

polygon.description: The room's 2D footprint in meters, floor-local coordinates. 3D geometry is extruded from this using the floor's height_m.

room.description: A room: a named, typed 2D footprint on one floor.

room_id.description: Id of the room whose polygon edge hosts this opening. Must be one of the opening's room_ids (a real room, never 'EXTERIOR').

edge_index.description: Index i of the host edge: the wall from polygon vertex i to vertex (i+1) mod n of the referenced room. Must be < the polygon's vertex count.

t0.description: Normalized start of the opening along the edge (0 = at vertex i, 1 = at vertex i+1). Must be < t1.

t1.description: Normalized end of the opening along the edge. Must be > t0.

wall_segment.description: Parametric placement of an opening on a wall: (room polygon edge, t-range). Because placement is relative to the edge, dragging a wall in the editor moves its doors and windows automatically.

viable.description: Whether this opening qualifies as an emergency escape/egress path per the thresholds in backend/corpus/egress_thresholds.json (window size, sill height; door width/height).

reasons.description: Human-readable reasons when viable is false (e.g. "width 0.40m < required 0.508m"). Empty when viable.

egress.description: COMPUTED egress assessment written back by the S1.1 egress annotator — never authored by hand or by the AI. Absent until the annotator runs.

id.description: Unique id of the opening across the whole home.

kind.description: Opening type. Routing prefers doors over windows via edge-weight penalties; windows must pass egress thresholds to count as escape paths.

room_ids.description: The two spaces this opening connects. Two room ids = an interior opening (adjacency); one room id + the reserved 'EXTERIOR' pseudo-room = an exit to the outside. Both entries being 'EXTERIOR' is invalid.

width_m.description: Clear opening width in meters. Authoritative for egress checks (the t-range is placement, not size).

sill_height_m.description: Height of the opening's bottom above the floor, in meters. 0 for doors. Matters for window egress (IRC max sill 1.118m / 44in).

opening.description: A door or window placed parametrically on a wall segment, connecting two rooms or a room and EXTERIOR.

id.description: Unique id of the floor across the whole home.

level.description: Vertical ordering of the floor: 0 = ground, 1 = second story, -1 = basement. Unique across floors.

height_m.description: Floor-to-ceiling height in meters; the extrusion height for this floor's room polygons.

rooms.description: Rooms whose footprints live on this floor (floor-local coordinate frame).

openings.description: Doors and windows on this floor. An opening's room_ids must reference rooms on this same floor (or 'EXTERIOR').

floor.description: One story of the home: rooms plus the openings that connect them.

room_id.description: Id of an existing room on that floor (the room the stair lands in).

stair_end.description: One endpoint of a stair: the (floor, room) it connects.

id.description: Unique id of the stair across the whole home.

from.description: Lower endpoint (by convention the lower floor; the graph edge is bidirectional).

to.description: Upper endpoint. Must be on a different floor than 'from'.

footprint.description: 2D footprint of the stair run for rendering (in the 'from' floor's coordinate frame).

kind.description: Stair shape, used only by the renderer's proxy geometry.

stairs.description: A staircase connecting a room on one floor to a room on another; the only cross-floor connector in the navigation graph.

id.description: Unique id of the profile across the whole home.

tags.description: Traits that deterministically map to routing constraints and advice: mobility_limited → avoid_stairs + avoid_windows; child → window egress deprioritized + accompanied-adult framing. Empty = able-bodied adult.

bedroom_room_id.description: Id of the room this person sleeps in (their route origin at night). Must reference an existing room.

profile.description: A household member whose traits personalize routes and guidance.

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the document was created.

modified.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last mutation (the editor's autosave updates this).

address_optional.description: Optional free-text home address; null when the user hasn't provided one. Never required — the app works fully anonymously.
